description: 사용자 지시: 글로리아 퀘스트 테스트가 끝났으므로 임시 테스트 선택지([테스트] 글로리아 퀘스트 준비)와 그 함수를 삭제한다.

edits.old:
! JO9 MOD START GLORIA_QUEST_TEST_CHEAT_20261108
! TEMPORARY TEST CHEAT. Remove before release.
! Uses the assistant as successor when present, otherwise the slave, whose slot is then emptied.
$jo9_gloria_test = {
	if assistant_state = CONST_INT['slave_exist']:
		$jo9_gloria_successor_name = $assistant_name
		killvar 'jo9_gloria_successor_slave'
		copyarr 'jo9_gloria_successor_slave', 'assistant'
		$jo9_gloria_successor_image = '..\' + $iif($fullsecretary[assistant_type] ! '', $fullsecretary[assistant_type], $fullimage[assistant_type])
	elseif slave_state = CONST_INT['slave_exist']:
		$jo9_gloria_successor_name = $slave_name
		killvar 'jo9_gloria_successor_slave'
		copyarr 'jo9_gloria_successor_slave', 'slave'
		$jo9_gloria_successor_image = '..\' + $iif($fullsecretary[slave_type] ! '', $fullsecretary[slave_type], $fullimage[slave_type])
		dynamic $clear_slave_instance, 'slave'
	end
	if $jo9_gloria_successor_name ! '':
		jo9_gloria_successor = 1
		jo9_gloria_successor_day = day - 60
		jo9_gloria_event = 0
	end
}
! JO9 MOD END GLORIA_QUEST_TEST_CHEAT_20261108
